answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the economy deploys game-theoretic multi-agent auditing paired with topological cut verifications. Auditors isolate sparse network cuts, slashing any dishonest cluster's stake. Like a vigilant falcon surveying peer graph bottlenecks, this forces an attacker to purchase vast independent identities across distinct clusters, driving identity generation costs to scale superlinearly. At the zenith of coordination, counterfeit agents become an unviable economic relic.
